scenes.say: Async or threads? Which should you use for your next project?

scenes.label: EventLoop
scenes.sub: Handles many I/O tasks without threads.
scenes.say: Async and await use an event loop to handle many input and output tasks without spinning up threads.

right.title: Threads
items: Best for CPU-bound or blocking work

scenes.say: Event loops rely on cooperative multitasking, perfect for I/O-bound jobs. Threads use preemptive multitasking, so they're best for CPU-heavy or blocking tasks.
In Node, async functions with await use the event loop. In Python, asyncio does the same for async input and output.

scenes.question: Should you use threads for I/O tasks?
scenes.right: No, async is better for I/O-bound work.
scenes.say: Here's a classic interview trap: Should you always use threads for input and output tasks? No—async is usually the better choice.
